title: The KERALA STATE RIGHT TO SERVICE ACT 2012
full_text: The KERALA STATE RIGHT TO SERVICE ACT 2012 2012-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന സേവനാവകാശ ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201218 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2012-08-06 Act Year: 2012 Short Title: The KERALA STATE RIGHT TO SERVICE ACT 2012 Hindi Title: 2012-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന സേവനാവകാശ ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to provide for the delivery of services to the general public within the stipulated time limit and for matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
